name: theater
title: Theater
description: Your home media stack in one place: Jellyfin, Jellyseerr, Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr, NZBHydra2, Bazarr, SABnzbd, qBittorrent, Navidrome, Audiobookshelf, Kavita, Shelfmark, Filebrowser and Homepage. Every service is a settings group; only the ones you fill in light up.
author: pal

settings.label: Jellyfin API key
settings.description: Dashboard › API Keys on the server.

settings.label: Jellyfin user
settings.description: Whose Continue Watching and watched state; the first user when empty.

settings.label: Jellyseerr API key
settings.description: Settings › General on Jellyseerr (Overseerr works the same).

settings.label: SABnzbd API key
settings.description: Config › General › API key (the NZB key is not enough for the queue).

settings.label: qBittorrent API key
settings.description: qBittorrent 5.2+: a bearer key (POST /api/v2/app/rotateAPIKey from a logged-in session). Leave empty to sign in with the WebUI user and password instead.

settings.label: Navidrome password
settings.description: Sent as a Subsonic salted token, never in clear.

settings.label: Homepage URL
settings.description: The dashboard; opened from the Theater palette.

theater.title: Theater
theater.description: Every configured service as a row with live health (up or down, version, one key number); Enter opens its web UI, cmd+Enter its palette in pal. A service you have not set up is one Set up row.

jellyfin.title: Jellyfin
jellyfin.description: Continue Watching with the position, then the latest additions, posters on the rows; the pane has the overview, year, rating, runtime and watched state.

keys.title: Play on a device (a picker of the signed-in sessions)
Add to or remove from favourites

jellyfin-search.title: Search Jellyfin
jellyfin-search.description: Movies, series, episodes, albums and songs by title, 300 ms after the last key; the same actions as the Jellyfin rows.

jellyfin-playing.title: Now Playing on Jellyfin
jellyfin-playing.description: Active sessions: who watches what on which device, with the position; Enter opens the item, cmd+Enter pauses or resumes that session.

jellyfin-play.title: Play on
jellyfin-play.description: The picker Play on a device opens: every Jellyfin session that takes remote control; Enter plays the item there.

keys.title: Play the item on that session

seerr-requests.title: Requests
seerr-requests.description: Jellyseerr requests, pending first, with the poster, who asked and the status; Approve and Decline on a pending one. The filter narrows to pending, approved, available or all.

seerr-request.title: Request a title
seerr-request.description: Search TMDB through Jellyseerr; Enter requests the movie or series (asks first), cmd+Enter in 4K when the server allows it. A title already available or requested is tagged.

radarr.title: Radarr
radarr.description: The queue with progress and status, the next seven days, health warnings, and the commands: add a movie, wanted, history, sync the watchlist now, open Radarr.

radarr-add.title: Add a movie
radarr-add.description: Look a movie up on Radarr; Enter adds it with the default quality profile and root folder and searches (asks first). One already in the library is tagged.

radarr-wanted.title: Wanted movies
radarr-wanted.description: Monitored movies without a file, newest release first; Enter searches for one, cmd+Enter opens it.

radarr-history.title: Radarr history
radarr-history.description: What Radarr grabbed, imported or failed on lately.

sonarr.title: Sonarr
sonarr.description: The queue with progress and status, the episodes airing in the next seven days, health warnings, and the commands: add a series, wanted, history, sync the watchlist now, open Sonarr.

sonarr-add.title: Add a series
sonarr-add.description: Look a series up on Sonarr; Enter adds it with the default quality profile and root folder, every season monitored, and searches (asks first).

sonarr-wanted.title: Wanted episodes
sonarr-wanted.description: Monitored episodes that aired without a file, newest first; Enter searches for one.

sonarr-history.title: Sonarr history
sonarr-history.description: What Sonarr grabbed, imported or failed on lately.

lidarr.title: Lidarr
lidarr.description: The queue with progress and status, albums out in the next seven days, health warnings, and the commands: add an artist, wanted, history, open Lidarr.

lidarr-add.title: Add an artist
lidarr-add.description: Look an artist up on Lidarr; Enter adds them with the default profiles and root folder and searches for missing albums (asks first).

lidarr-wanted.title: Wanted albums
lidarr-wanted.description: Monitored albums without files, newest first; Enter searches for one.

lidarr-history.title: Lidarr history
lidarr-history.description: What Lidarr grabbed, imported or failed on lately.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.description: SABnzbd and qBittorrent as one queue: each item with progress, speed, time left and category; pause, resume and delete per item; Pause all, Resume all and a speed limit on top.

downloads-history.title: Download history
downloads-history.description: What SABnzbd and qBittorrent finished lately, a failed one with its reason.

prowlarr.title: Indexers
prowlarr.description: Every Prowlarr indexer with protocol, priority and health (a disabled or failing one says why), Prowlarr's own health warnings, and NZBHydra2's indexers when configured.

prowlarr-search.title: Search indexers
prowlarr-search.description: A release search across every Prowlarr indexer: title, size, age, seeders or grabs, the indexer as a tag; Enter grabs it through Prowlarr into the download client (asks first).

hydra-search.title: Search NZBHydra2
hydra-search.description: A usenet search through NZBHydra2: title, size, age, grabs, the indexer as a tag; Enter sends the NZB to SABnzbd when it is configured, else opens Hydra.

keys.title: Send to SABnzbd (asks first), or open in Hydra

navidrome.title: Navidrome
navidrome.description: What is playing now, then the albums added lately with their covers; Enter opens in Navidrome, cmd+S stars.

navidrome-search.title: Search Navidrome
navidrome-search.description: Artists, albums and songs with cover art, 300 ms after the last key.

abs.title: Audiobookshelf
abs.description: Continue listening with the progress, then what was added lately across your libraries; Enter opens in Audiobookshelf.

abs-search.title: Search Audiobookshelf
abs-search.description: Books, podcasts and authors across every library.

kavita.title: Kavita
kavita.description: Continue reading with the pages read, then the series added lately; Enter opens the web reader.

kavita-search.title: Search Kavita
kavita-search.description: Series, collections and files across your libraries.

shelfmark.title: Request a book
shelfmark.description: Search Shelfmark's book provider; Enter lists the releases found for the book, and Enter on one downloads it into the ebook library (asks first). With nothing typed, what Shelfmark is downloading now.

shelfmark-releases.title: Releases
shelfmark-releases.description: The releases Shelfmark found for one book (opened from Request a book): format, size, source, seeders; Enter downloads (asks first).

bazarr.title: Subtitles
bazarr.description: Bazarr: how many movies and episodes still want subtitles, each provider's health, and the wanted items with the missing languages; Search missing subtitles runs Bazarr's task.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.description: SABnzbd and qBittorrent together: the download speed and how many items are active; hidden while both are idle. The popover lists the queue with progress bars, space pauses or resumes everything.

keys.title: Open the client of the focused item

playing.title: Now Playing
playing.description: Who is watching what on Jellyfin: the count on the strip, the sessions with progress in the popover; hidden while nothing plays.

item.title: cagdas
item.tooltip: cagdas · Barry S1E4 on the living room TV
cagdas and a guest are watching

keys.title: Pause or resume the focused session

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Pending Jellyseerr requests as the badge, hidden at zero; the popover lists them with the poster; a approves and d declines the focused one.

queue.title: Arr queue
queue.description: What Radarr, Sonarr and Lidarr are fetching or importing: the count on the strip, amber when an item is stuck (an import that needs a hand, a failed download); hidden while every queue is empty.

keys.title: Remove the focused item from its queue (asks first)
Open the app's palette in pal

downloading.description: Items downloading across SABnzbd and qBittorrent

speed.description: Combined download speed, bytes per second

queued.description: Items across the Radarr, Sonarr and Lidarr queues

stuck.description: Queue items with a warning or an error

search.description: Open Search Jellyfin with a query typed

request.description: Open Request a title with a query typed

q.description: The title to look up on Jellyseerr

sync-watchlist.description: Run an import list sync now (Radarr, Sonarr)

app.description: radarr or sonarr; both when omitted

service.description: jellyfin, seerr, radarr, sonarr, lidarr, prowlarr, hydra, bazarr, sab, qbit, navidrome, abs, kavita, shelfmark, filebrowser, homepage

store.tagline: Jellyfin, the arrs, the download clients, music, books: one extension
features: Theater: every configured service as a row with live health, Enter to its web UI, cmd+Enter into its palette
Jellyfin: Continue Watching and Latest with posters, search with a detail pane, Now Playing, play on a device, mark played, favourite
Jellyseerr: requests with Approve and Decline, Request a title through TMDB search, 4K when enabled
Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr: queue, calendar, wanted, history, add with the default profile, sync the Trakt watchlist now
SABnzbd and qBittorrent as one Downloads queue: pause, resume, delete, a speed limit; history with failure reasons
Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 searches, indexer health; Navidrome, Audiobookshelf and Kavita with cover art; Shelfmark book requests; Bazarr wanted subtitles
Four bar items: downloads speed, who is watching, pending requests, the arr queue; each hidden when it has nothing to say
